```{r Creacion de variables dicotómicas}
train <- read.csv("train.csv")

set.seed(245)
porciento <- 0.7
corte <- sample(nrow(train), nrow(train) * porciento)
train_data <- train[corte, ]
test_data <- train[-corte, ]

mean_price <- mean(train_data$SalePrice, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_price <- sd(train_data$SalePrice, na.rm = TRUE)
lower_limit <- median(train_data$SalePrice)
upper_limit <- mad(train_data$SalePrice)

train_data$Category <- ifelse(train_data$SalePrice < (lower_limit - upper_limit), "Baratas",
                        ifelse(train_data$SalePrice > (lower_limit + upper_limit), "Caras", "Medianas"))

test_data$Category <- ifelse(test_data$SalePrice < (lower_limit - upper_limit), "Baratas",
                       ifelse(test_data$SalePrice > (lower_limit + upper_limit), "Caras", "Medianas"))

train_data$Es_Cara <- ifelse(train_data$Category == "Caras", 1, 0)
train_data$Es_Media <- ifelse(train_data$Category == "Medianas", 1, 0)
train_data$Es_Barata <- ifelse(train_data$Category == "Baratas", 1, 0)

test_data$Es_Cara <- ifelse(test_data$Category == "Caras", 1, 0)
test_data$Es_Media <- ifelse(test_data$Category == "Medianas", 1, 0)
test_data$Es_Barata <- ifelse(test_data$Category == "Baratas", 1, 0)

table(train_data$Es_Cara)
table(train_data$Es_Media)
table(train_data$Es_Barata)
```

```{r Paso 2 - Preparacion de los conjuntos de entrenamiento y prueba}
numeric_vars <- c("OverallQual", "GrLivArea", "GarageCars", "TotalBsmtSF", 
                 "FullBath", "YearBuilt", "YearRemodAdd", "Fireplaces",
                 "BsmtFinSF1", "LotArea", "MasVnrArea", "WoodDeckSF")

categorical_vars <- c("Neighborhood", "ExterQual", "KitchenQual", "BsmtQual", 
                     "GarageFinish", "Foundation", "MSZoning", "CentralAir")

for(var in numeric_vars) {
  if(sum(is.na(train_data[[var]])) > 0) {
    median_value <- median(train_data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
    train_data[[var]][is.na(train_data[[var]])] <- median_value
  }
  
  if(sum(is.na(test_data[[var]])) > 0) {
    median_value <- median(train_data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
    test_data[[var]][is.na(test_data[[var]])] <- median_value
  }
}

for(var in categorical_vars) {
  if(sum(is.na(train_data[[var]])) > 0) {
    mode_value <- names(sort(table(train_data[[var]]), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
    train_data[[var]][is.na(train_data[[var]])] <- mode_value
  }
  
  if(sum(is.na(test_data[[var]])) > 0) {
    mode_value <- names(sort(table(train_data[[var]]), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
    test_data[[var]][is.na(test_data[[var]])] <- mode_value
  }
  
  all_levels <- unique(c(levels(factor(train_data[[var]])), levels(factor(test_data[[var]]))))
  train_data[[var]] <- factor(train_data[[var]], levels = all_levels)
  test_data[[var]] <- factor(test_data[[var]], levels = all_levels)
}

predictors_cat <- train_data[, categorical_vars]
dummies <- dummyVars(~ ., data = predictors_cat, fullRank = TRUE)
predictors_cat_encoded <- predict(dummies, predictors_cat)

X_train <- cbind(train_data[, numeric_vars], predictors_cat_encoded)
y_train <- train_data$Es_Cara  

preproc <- preProcess(X_train, method = c("center", "scale"))
X_train_scaled <- predict(preproc, X_train)

predictors_cat_test <- test_data[, categorical_vars]
predictors_cat_test_encoded <- predict(dummies, predictors_cat_test)
X_test <- cbind(test_data[, numeric_vars], predictors_cat_test_encoded)

train_cols <- colnames(X_train)
test_cols <- colnames(X_test)

missing_in_test <- setdiff(train_cols, test_cols)
missing_in_train <- setdiff(test_cols, train_cols)

if(length(missing_in_test) > 0) {
  for(col in missing_in_test) {
    X_test[, col] <- 0
  }
}

if(length(missing_in_train) > 0) {
  X_test <- X_test[, !(colnames(X_test) %in% missing_in_train)]
}

X_test <- X_test[, colnames(X_train)]
X_test_scaled <- predict(preproc, X_test)

y_test <- test_data$Es_Cara
```

```{r Paso 3 - Modelo de regresion logistica}
set.seed(245)
train_control <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 10,
  savePredictions = "all",
  classProbs = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = twoClassSummary
)

logistic_model <- train(
  x = X_train_scaled,
  y = factor(y_train, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Si")),
  method = "glm",
  family = "binomial",
  trControl = train_control,
  metric = "ROC"
)

summary(logistic_model$finalModel)

print(logistic_model)

varImp_plot <- varImp(logistic_model)
plot(varImp_plot, top = 20, main = "Importancia de Variables")
```
